comment: Panel lettering differs from the code names: the panel prints TIME for what the code calls reverb time and LATE for what it calls tail level. The lines use the panel's words. One oddity in the code: when a reverb engine is first built, the decay CV is scaled by 10000 rather than the 10 used from then on, so a decay CV present at the moment a cable is patched in can set an extreme first value.
